step_a: Infer frame-enclosed pockets and follow the marker-associated indicator network to select the pockets touched by its clean branches.
intermediate: The set of selected enclosure cells, which varies with indicator routing even when all enclosure geometry is held fixed.
step_b: Paint only the selected pocket cells with the inferred singleton marker color.
why_b_depends_on_a: Which of 4-16 varied pockets is selected changes across inputs. Protected paired reroutes retain identical enclosures but change the selected cells. Fixed-position, enclosure-only and simple object-selection rivals are rejected by the minimum demonstration prefix in the retained bounded audit.

(rule! (lambda (g)
 (let ()
  (define H (rows g)) (define W (cols g)) (define D cardinal-deltas)
  (define colors (remove-duplicates (flatten g)))
  (define bg (car (sort colors (lambda (a b) (> (count-color g a) (count-color g b))))))
  (define markers (filter (lambda (v) (and (not (= v bg)) (= (count-color g v) 1))) colors))
  (define m (first markers))
  (define mp (first (find-color g m)))
  (define (inside? p) (and (<= 0 (first p)) (< (first p) H) (<= 0 (second p)) (< (second p) W)))
  (define (nbrs p) (filter inside? (map (lambda (d) (list (+ (first p) (first d)) (+ (second p) (second d)))) D)))
  (define ivals (filter (lambda (v) (and (not (= v bg)) (not (= v m)))) (map (lambda (x) (at g (first x) (second x))) (nbrs mp))))
  (define ind (first ivals))
  (define frame (car (sort (filter (lambda (v) (and (not (= v bg)) (not (= v m)) (not (= v ind)))) colors)
                           (lambda (a b) (> (count-color g a) (count-color g b))))))
  (define (component start)
   (let loop ((todo (list start)) (seen '()))
    (if (null? todo) seen
     (let ((x (car todo)))
      (if (member x seen) (loop (cdr todo) seen)
       (loop (append (cdr todo) (filter (lambda (y) (and (= (at g (first y) (second y)) bg) (not (member y seen)))) (nbrs x))) (cons x seen)))))))
  (define (boundary c) (remove-duplicates (apply append (map (lambda (x) (filter (lambda (y) (not (member y c))) (nbrs x))) c))))
  (let loop ((left (find-color g bg)) (out g))
   (if (null? left) out
    (let* ((c (component (car left))) (rest (filter (lambda (x) (not (member x c))) left)) (b (boundary c)))
     (loop rest (if (and (not (null? b)) (andmap (lambda (x) (= (at g (first x) (second x)) frame)) b)) (paint-cells out c m) out))))))))
